# Soul & Fuel Media

> Bengaluru photography and film studio. Most of the work is interior,
> architecture, hotel, resort and real estate photography for architects,
> interior designers, developers and hospitality brands. The studio also
> makes travel films and corporate films. Founded and run by Mahesh S.
> Also written as "Soul and Fuel Media" or "Soul & Fuel".

## What we do
- Interior & architecture photography: homes, apartments, offices, showrooms, cafes and restaurants
- Hotel & resort photography: rooms, common areas, exteriors and grounds
- Real estate photography for developers
- Portfolio shoots for interior designers and architects
- Travel films
- Corporate and brand films

## Selected work
- Hospitality: Aalterra Resort (Wayanad), The Old Acre (Wayanad), Magnolia Resorts (Coorg), Hotel GSR (Tumkur), Yolotel (Bengaluru), Flair Restaurant (Tumkur), Bunsik Cafe (Bengaluru)
- Commercial & architecture: CapitaLand (Bengaluru and Hyderabad), Countryside Raindance, Subha White Waters, DNR Highline (Bengaluru)
- Residential: Tata Promont, Prestige Avalon Park, Sobha Windsor, Sobha Malachite, Shapoorji Pallonji, Brigade Utopia (Bengaluru); Marina One (Kochi); In The Hills (Chikmagalur)
- Interior designers we shoot for include Style My Kona, Eden Elements, Syzygy Designz, Inspacio Design Studio, Tesor Designs, Maysons, Kham Design, Manmeet Bevli Designs, The Zen Theory and FY Design Studio

## Published in
Elle Decor India, India Today Homes, Architect & Interiors India, Good Homes India, The New Indian Express, Home Publication

## Where we work
Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. We work across India, including Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala and all of Karnataka (Mysuru, Coorg, Chikkamagaluru, Sakleshpur, Hampi).

## Hours
Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 7:00 pm IST. Closed Sunday.
